messages:
Jules (growth): quick experiment idea — add a minimal pricing calculator card into docs sidebars (near API examples). goal: capture dev intent earlier and test alternative tier names (Starter/Pro/Enterprise vs Lite/Team/Enterprise). keep it small: one input (tokens/mo) -> estimate + suggested tier chip.
Rina (analytics): baseline: docs -> paid conversion 2.0%. target lift +0.7pp. we'll randomize at doc path level. required events: estimator_shown, estimate_submitted, recommended_tier, variant. set 14-day paid conversion window.
Owen (design): uploaded compact mock: https://figma.com/s/mini-estimator-card — has micro-FAQ accordion and rationale tooltip for suggested tier. Variant A uses Lite/Team/Enterprise, Variant B uses Starter/Pro/Enterprise.
Hannah (sales): routing: if suggested tier == Enterprise then flag as `sales_priority=high`. otherwise route to nurture. Please include `suggested_route` in webhook. Also if estimate_usd > $1000, auto-tag AE.
Jules (growth): sample payload for infra: {"session_id":"<anon>", "monthly_tokens":300000, "estimate_usd":180, "recommended_tier":"Pro", "suggested_route":"nurture", "referrer":"docs-getting-started"} — include experiment_id and variant.
DeployBot: feature-flagged, canary 7% docs traffic -> 35% -> 100% over 72h. staging passed.
Rina (analytics): I'll build the quick dashboard and include cohort waterfall by referrer. also want to capture clicks to FAQ and Talk-to-sales.
Owen (design): UX note — keep copy terse: CTA 'Estimate cost' and small link 'Pricing FAQ'. show 'Talk to sales' only on Enterprise chip.
Hannah (sales): webinar mention — if Enterprise suggestions spike, we should run a 30-min billing + capacity session and include CTA from the card. I'll prep slide outline.
Jules (growth): timeline: dev this sprint, analytics ready next Tue, run 3 weeks. reconvene after 5 days for early signal. thanks all! :rocket:
